title: MZ Show ALL equipment (weapons, armor, accesory, etc.) in menu

posts.author: cozathemaster
posts.body:
By default, in RPG Maker MZ, if you have a weapon or armor that is not equipped, it will appear in the "items" scene within the menu. However, if you equip that weapon or armor to an actor, it stops appearing in that menu. This can be useful on the equip screen so that unavailable gear doesn’t show up, but I would like all weapons and armors to appear on the items screen, so that the player can see the complete inventory they have. Is there any way to do that?
Thank you in advance for your help!!!
PS: I'm providing a reference image so you know what I mean. In the image, that armor is shown because it hasn't been equipped to any actor yet. Once it's equipped, it can no longer be seen in this menu.
